# Example: untrusted and out-of-scope peer
`crier:client-rogue` fails authentication and receives `403 peer_authentication_failed`. A trusted `client-alpha` requests `room:private`, outside its `FederationMap` scopes; the controller returns `403 peer_scope_denied` (or `202 pending_local_approval` only when local owner policy explicitly selects wait). A payload asserting `as: vp` returns `403 peer_vp_claim`.
Only audit records are written on denial: no local objective, dispatch, grant, or room message. Connectivity and a peer certificate never confer local VP status.
